$comment: Source of truth for the motion sector of the partner programs tracker (scripts/partner-programs.mjs). Record a submission with npm run programs -- --log <id> --action "...", a benefit with npm run programs -- --benefit <id> --name "...". Never set status member without proof. Never store organization, workspace, or account IDs here.

companies.name: Pixiv
companies.angle: Get the VRoid Hub app approved and keep contributing to three-vrm, which we already depend on.

companies.name: Blender
companies.angle: Submit the packaged three.ws Forge extension to Blender Extensions (free); the Development Fund is a paid, optional follow-up.

companies.name: Mesh2Motion
companies.angle: Contribute upstream and cross-link; our CC0 library already pins its packs.

companies.name: Quaternius
companies.angle: Sponsor via Patreon and credit publicly; clips already feed our CC0 library.

companies.name: Sketchfab
companies.angle: Keep the showcase cron, re-establish contact with KitBash, aim for Staff Picks.

companies.name: Avaturn
companies.angle: Already integrated via src/avatar-creator.js and src/avaturn-client.js: request a case study, works-with badge and a joint migration page.

companies.name: Uthana
companies.angle: Strongest commercial motion partner: license labeled clips to replace Mixamo and use the API as a paid lane; propose a joint open-source web player story.

companies.name: DeepMotion
companies.angle: Request Animate 3D API access as a failover rung behind our text2motion and video2motion workers; ask for SayMotion verification and a technology-partner listing alongside Avaturn.

companies.name: Move AI
companies.angle: Offer Move API as a paid markerless lane beside workers/model-video2motion; mind the EULA video licence.

companies.name: Rokoko
companies.angle: Pitch a Studio Live receiver and BVH import so a Rokoko suit drives a three.ws agent, using the retargeter in src/glb-canonicalize.js; apply for sponsored creator reach with a demo.

companies.name: VRM Consortium
companies.angle: Join as a supporting member for credibility; ask for fee details.

companies.name: Bones Studio
companies.angle: Apply for the startup BONES-SEED licence for evaluation and retarget testing; respect the generative-model ban.

companies.name: CGTrader
companies.angle: Secondary storefront for CC0 and labeled generated packs once its AI-content rules are confirmed.

companies.name: Plask
companies.angle: Self-serve key now: add Plask as a lane and map its SMPL24 poses through our SMPL handling.

companies.name: Reallusion
companies.angle: Highlight the shipped CC_Base_ bone map, ask for a works-with listing, and ask about web-playback licensing for ActorCore; sell captured packs only if we build a library.

companies.name: Sony
companies.angle: Build a mocopi BVH-over-UDP receiver bridge and email mocopi-support@sony.com for a commercial-use blessing and developer-event slot.

companies.name: Genies
companies.angle: Competitor reference; Unity-only SDK, low priority.

companies.name: Kinetix
companies.angle: Low priority: contact about web emote delivery; verify the grant claim first.

companies.name: Meta
companies.angle: Low fit; Unity and Unreal only.

companies.name: Cascadeur
companies.angle: Ingest its FBX/GLB output; ask sales@cascadeur.com about affiliate.

companies.name: Mocap Online
companies.angle: Possible clean-licence commissioning via IP-Share; not a promotion channel.

companies.name: Truebones
companies.angle: Ask for explicit redistribution terms before using non-human rigs publicly.

companies.name: Xsens
companies.angle: Skip hardware programs; only note the free Notary data and the 10 December contest.

companies.name: Noitom
companies.angle: No program; stream Axis Studio BVH into the avatar runtime as a demo.

companies.name: OptiTrack
companies.angle: No program; consider an open-source NatNet bridge.

companies.name: Shutterstock
companies.angle: TurboSquid bans AI-generated content; skip for Forge output.

companies.name: Vicon
companies.angle: Register interest only if a Vicon import is added.

companies.name: Adobe
companies.angle: Mixamo has no partner route; keep Mixamo clips out of the public library and ask Adobe for written permission only if needed.

companies.name: Meshcapade
companies.angle: Closed; verify SMPL licensing with Max Planck Innovation before relying on SMPL weights.

companies.name: Radical
companies.angle: Closed; target its stranded users with /video-to-motion.

companies.name: Ready Player Me
companies.angle: Retired; capture its refugees with the existing import page.

programs.program: three-vrm open-source contributions
programs.apply: GitHub issues and pull requests
benefits: Upstream our retargeter fixes
Possible listing in three-vrm examples and community pages
programs.eligibility: Open source, MIT
programs.next: Upstream a real fix or example from our pose-solve work to pixiv/three-vrm, then ask to be listed among projects that use it
programs.why: Core dependency already (pose-solve, avatar export); contributions are the cheapest credibility win in the VRM world. Evidence: src/runtime/pose-solve.js. Using the library is not a partnership; a merged contribution is the route.

programs.program: VRoid Hub API approved application
programs.apply: Register at hub.vroid.com/developer/registration, create an app at hub.vroid.com/oauth/applications, then contact VRoid via the inquiry form on vroid.pixiv.help to get approved
benefits: Immediate API/SDK access after developer registration
Approved apps can publish on VRoid Hub; unapproved apps see a limited model set and a warning
Approved apps are listed on hub.vroid.com/apps (per docs/partners/prospects.md, not re-verified)
programs.eligibility: Developer registration on VRoid Hub; approval review
programs.cadence: rolling (reply about a week per developer.vroid.com, per prospects.md)
programs.next: Apply through the program page
programs.why: VRM and J_Bip bone maps already ship in the canonicalizer, so an approved VRoid import app is a small step.
programs.promo_note: Approved applications appear in the VRoid Hub apps list; apply through the approval inquiry form (listing detail from prospects.md).

programs.program: Blender Extensions platform (three.ws Forge add-on)
programs.apply: Upload a zip with blender_manifest.toml with a Blender ID, then wait for community review (steps in integrations/blender/SUBMITTING.md)
benefits: Appears in Blender 4.2+ Get Extensions for every user
GPL-compatible add-ons only
programs.eligibility: GPL-compliant extension, public review
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: Our extension is packaged (id three_ws, GPL-3.0-or-later) but the listing URL in integrations/blender/README.md returns 404 on 2026-11-06, so it is not live; submit it.

programs.program: Blender Development Fund corporate membership
programs.apply: Bronze, Silver, Gold via checkout at fund.blender.org; Platinum, Titanium, Patron via francesco@blender.org
benefits: Bronze EUR 6k and Silver EUR 12k: logo and URL
Gold EUR 30k: plus social media mention, credit in reports and at events
Platinum EUR 60k: plus a developer liaison
Titanium EUR 120k: plus blender.org front page mention and board contact
Patron EUR 240k: plus press release, tech blog post, dedicated product manager
programs.eligibility: Companies; fees are donations and do not imply alignment (per Blender policy)
programs.next: Bronze, Silver, Gold via checkout at fund.blender.org; Platinum, Titanium, Patron via francesco@blender.org
programs.why: Out of budget for a small startup beyond symbolic tiers; our integrations/blender add-on gives a free route to the same community.
programs.promo_note: Tier dependent: logo/URL from Bronze, social mention and event credit from Gold, press release and tech blog post only at Patron.

programs.program: Mesh2Motion open-source animation app and CC0 library
programs.apply: GitHub issues and PRs; mesh2motion.org (no sponsorship page found)
benefits: MIT code, CC0 art and animations
Accepts contributions to mesh2motion-assets
programs.eligibility: Open source
programs.next: GitHub issues and PRs; mesh2motion.org (no sponsorship page found)
programs.why: Open alternative to Mixamo that we already source clips from (pinned by commit in cc0-animation-library); contribute upstream and cross-link.

programs.program: Quaternius Patreon and Universal Animation Library
programs.apply: Patreon at patreon.com/quaternius; email the contact address on their site (printed on the site)
benefits: CC0 Universal Animation Library, 120+ clips on a universal humanoid rig
Patrons get monthly credits toward source keys
programs.eligibility: Patreon pledge; CC0 assets need no permission
programs.next: Patreon at patreon.com/quaternius; email the contact address on their site (printed on the site)
programs.why: Quaternius is named in our canonicalizer and its clips feed the CC0 library; a sponsorship plus public credit is a cheap goodwill step.

programs.program: Sketchfab Data, Download and Viewer APIs, Staff Picks (now owned by KitBash)
programs.apply: OAuth app and API token through the Sketchfab developer docs; Staff Picks is editorial
benefits: Data API v3 uploads and collections, Viewer API, Download API (glTF, GLB, USDZ), oEmbed
Large 3D audience for showcase uploads
programs.eligibility: Sketchfab account; Created With AI tag required for generated models (per prospects.md citing Sketchfab policy)
programs.next: Pitch the best showcase uploads for Staff Picks and ask the KitBash team whether a partner or API showcase route exists after the acquisition
programs.why: KitBash acquired Sketchfab and ArtStation from Epic (announced 2026-08-10) with no immediate changes; Epic still runs Fab. Our showcase cron already uploads; refresh contact with the new owner and aim for Staff Picks. Evidence: api/cron/sketchfab-showcase.js.
programs.promo_note: Staff Picks are curated by Sketchfab staff; the only route is quality uploads plus the right tags (track record, no published submission form).

programs.program: Avaturn Developer plan, SDK and Partners/Agencies programs
programs.apply: Developer portal purchase for Pro; 'Reach out to us' on Enterprise; Agencies page; hello@in3d.io per docs/partners/prospects.md
benefits: Pro USD 800 per month: API and SDK, own branding and user management, up to 1,000 avatars then USD 0.15 each
Enterprise: full-body scans, dedicated servers, custom terms, Slack support
Free Unity SDK on the Asset Store (mentions Partners and Beta programs)
programs.eligibility: Paid plan; no startup discount on the pricing page
programs.next: Email Avaturn: the integration is live (src/avaturn-client.js); ask for a co-published case study, a works-with badge and a listing on their partners page
programs.why: Already integrated (AvatarCreator + session endpoint); ask for a co-published case study and a 'works with' badge, plus a joint landing page for avatar users stranded by Ready Player Me. Evidence: src/avaturn-client.js.

programs.program: Uthana API (text to motion, video to motion, retarget, auto-rig)
programs.apply: Self-serve account; GraphQL API shares credits with the web app. Support support@uthana.com, Discord
benefits: Pay-as-you-go credits, no subscription or minimum
Video-to-motion USD 0.05 per second of input video (per Uthana)
Public Blender and Maya plugins
programs.eligibility: Account only
programs.next: Self-serve account; GraphQL API shares credits with the web app. Support support@uthana.com, Discord
programs.why: Drop-in commercial motion lane behind our open-source one; self-serve so no application wait.

programs.program: Uthana motion data licensing and enterprise partnerships
programs.apply: Email sales@uthana.com (request a data sample, catalog and delivery spec)
benefits: Studio Motion Dataset: 250+ hours marker-based, performer-consented, FBX/GLB/BVH
1,000+ hours of human motion across collections
Custom data programs and enterprise integrations scoped per customer
programs.eligibility: Commercial training and evaluation rights by agreement; priced to scope
programs.next: Email sales@uthana.com (request a data sample, catalog and delivery spec)
programs.why: Licensed, labeled motion is the clean answer to our Mixamo licensing gap and could train or evaluate our text2motion lane; also a possible co-marketing partner for an open-source web player.

programs.program: DeepMotion Animate 3D API and SayMotion API partner access
programs.apply: Create an Animate 3D account, then submit the 'Animate 3D API Access Request Form'; high-volume plans via deepmotion.com/contact; SayMotion API is limited to verified partners
benefits: REST API for video-to-animation with FBX/BVH output and retargeting (per the API page)
SayMotion text-to-motion API for verified partners
Free API trials for select partners (per SayMotion V2.3 announcement, 2024, may have changed)
programs.eligibility: Account plus access request form; SayMotion API by verification
programs.next: Apply through the program page
programs.why: Text-to-motion and video-to-motion are exactly our Forge motion lanes; DeepMotion would be a paid failover rung behind workers/model-text2motion and model-video2motion. It already lists Avaturn and Ready Player Me as technology partners.

programs.program: Move AI Developer Partner Programme (Move API)
programs.apply: Sign-up page partners.moveaitech.com (could not be fetched from this environment, reported by search results) or Contact Sales on developers.move.ai
programs.value: Beta partner fee USD 190 per month with 4,000 credits (per search result of partners.moveaitech.com); pay-as-you-go also listed
benefits: Move API access with technical support and early access to new models (per search result of the sign-up page)
Pay-as-you-go from USD 0.012 per second (single camera s1) per developer docs
programs.eligibility: Limited availability, first come first served, beta API for testing; EULA grants Move AI a broad licence to input video to improve its products
programs.next: Sign-up page partners.moveaitech.com (could not be fetched from this environment, reported by search results) or Contact Sales on developers.move.ai
programs.why: A commercial markerless lane next to our own workers/model-video2motion, with video-in, FBX/BVH-out; read the EULA video-data licence before routing user footage.

programs.program: Rokoko Studio Live plugins, Command API and Device SDK (integrations)
programs.apply: No application. Public GitHub repos and sdk.rokoko.com; the only route to be listed is the general contact form at rokoko.com/get-in-touch
benefits: Studio Live plugins for Unreal, Unity, Blender, Maya and Cinema 4D (open on GitHub)
Studio Command API examples and a Device SDK for Smartgloves II
Exports FBX, BVH, CSV
programs.eligibility: Open repos; no partner gate. The site shows no submission process for a third-party integration listing
programs.cost: free (hardware and Studio licences are separate)
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: A three.ws receiver for Rokoko Studio Live streams (or BVH import into the retargeter in src/glb-canonicalize.js) would let a Rokoko suit drive a web agent; ask Rokoko to list it on their integrations page.

programs.program: Rokoko Sponsored Creator Program
programs.apply: Application form behind the 'Apply for a sponsorship' button on the page
benefits: Partial tier: discounts on Rokoko tools and extended reach through Rokoko channels
Complete tier: fully sponsored tools plus invitations to livestreams and judging panels
programs.eligibility: Partial: upcoming 3D artists with high-quality renders. Complete: established creators with a large multi-platform following. Creators must make content with Rokoko tools and use #madewithrokoko
programs.next: Application form behind the 'Apply for a sponsorship' button on the page
programs.why: Fits only as a creator route: a three.ws motion-to-avatar demo built on Rokoko Vision or Studio clips would qualify, but it is aimed at individual artists, not platforms.
programs.promo_note: Apply via the form; Rokoko extends reach through its channels (partial tier) and invites complete-tier creators to livestreams and judging panels. The page gives no guaranteed post commitment.

programs.program: VRM Consortium supporting membership
programs.apply: Email membership inquiries to vrmc-pr@vrm-consortium.org
benefits: Supporting member: priority information on VRM spec and guidelines
Event participation and member pricing
Listed on the members page
programs.eligibility: Companies; the consortium says it is looking for members; fees not published
programs.next: Email membership inquiries to vrmc-pr@vrm-consortium.org
programs.why: VRM is the open humanoid avatar standard our retargeter targets; membership adds credibility with the Japanese VTuber and avatar ecosystem.
programs.promo_note: Members are listed on the consortium site; ask the secretariat about event slots.

programs.program: BONES-SEED motion dataset licence (qualifying startups)
programs.apply: Email licensing@bones.studio; pricing at bones.studio/licensing
benefits: 142,000 motion sequences with semantic labels and text descriptions (SOMA skeleton, BVH/NPZ, plus Unitree G1 CSV)
Startups under USD 1M annual revenue may use it for internal R&D and commercialization
programs.eligibility: Commercial entities under USD 1M revenue, or academic. Forbids public mirrors and building competing datasets or generative motion models; attribution 'Motion Data by Bones Studio' required
programs.cost: free for qualifying startups, paid commercial licence otherwise
programs.next: Email licensing@bones.studio; pricing at bones.studio/licensing
programs.why: The generative-model ban blocks training our text2motion lane on it, but it works for evaluation, retarget testing and clip selection; read the full agreement before ingesting.

programs.program: CGTrader seller program, affiliate and API
programs.apply: Seller sign-up on cgtrader.com; API at api.cgtrader.com; affiliate listed by directories (terms not verified)
benefits: Sellers earn royalties (CGTrader claims up to 80 percent; sources conflict)
Free API and enterprise services pages
programs.eligibility: Seller account; AI-generated content rules not verified on the pages I reached
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: A secondary storefront for CC0 and labeled generated packs, and 20 percent affiliate referral per one directory (unverified).

programs.program: Plask Motion Capture API (REST and realtime)
programs.apply: Self-serve API key on the Plask Developer page; scopes jobs:read, jobs:write, live:write, usage:read
benefits: Video upload to job to download, with SSE progress
Realtime WebSocket pose streaming (plask.pose.v1, SMPL24 skeleton)
Credit-based usage; Unreal Live Link and Blender helpers
programs.eligibility: Plask account and credits; docs were updated 2026-10-11 and the older @plask-ai/client SDK is not drop-in compatible
programs.next: Self-serve API key on the Plask Developer page; scopes jobs:read, jobs:write, live:write, usage:read
programs.why: Contradicts the dormant note in docs/partners/prospects.md: the API is live. SMPL24 pose output maps straight onto the SMPL rig names our canonicalizer already handles.

programs.program: Reallusion Affiliate Program (Awin)
programs.apply: Free sign-up through the Awin network; questions to affiliate@reallusion.com
benefits: 15 percent commission per sale
30-day cookie
Covers Character Creator, iClone, Cartoon Animator and content packs
programs.eligibility: Awin publisher account
programs.next: Free sign-up through the Awin network; questions to affiliate@reallusion.com
programs.why: Low strategic fit; only useful if we publish a guide on moving Character Creator rigs (the CC_Base_ bone map already ships) into three.ws and want to monetise referrals.

programs.program: ActorCore Partner Program (motion capture, 3D scan partners)
programs.apply: 'Join Now' form on the partner page (options: Motion Capture Partner, 3D Scan Partner, Other); older announcement says marketing@reallusion.com
benefits: Sell motion packs and characters on ActorCore, Reallusion's motion marketplace
Reallusion is recruiting studios that produce motion capture and scans
programs.eligibility: Studios able to produce AAA-quality motion or scans; Content Developer Agreement bars selling the same content through other channels (per the agreement)
programs.cost: revenue share (50 percent of net sales stated for the Content Store in the agreement, which looks dated)
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: Only relevant if we produce our own capture library (video2motion plus text2motion output) and want a paid channel; the other direction, licensing ActorCore motions for web playback, would be a separate ask to the same team.

programs.program: Sony mocopi Developer Site (XYN) and commercial licence
programs.apply: Download SDKs from the XYN developer site; commercial licence via mocopi-support@sony.com (per the SDK EULA)
benefits: Receiver plugins for Unity, MotionBuilder, Unreal, Maya, Blender; Unity receiver open-sourced Dec 2025
Mobile SDK for Android and iOS (labelled for corporate customers)
BVH Sender and Motion Serializer
programs.eligibility: Developer registration; commercial use needs a licence agreement
programs.next: Download SDKs from the XYN developer site; commercial licence via mocopi-support@sony.com (per the SDK EULA)
programs.why: mocopi streams BVH over UDP; a browser receiver bridge would let a mocopi wearable animate any three.ws avatar. Sony has historically held developer events (mocopi Winter Camp).

programs.program: Genies Avatar SDK and developer program
programs.apply: Unity Asset Store package; early access applications for the Unity Editor integration; roadmap via genies.com/blog
benefits: Avatar SDK v3.8.6 (2026-06-13) with persistent cross-game identity
Planned Art Forge (generation) and Intelligence SDKs
IP partners include NBA Players Association, Webtoon, Sanrio
programs.eligibility: Unity 2022.3.62+ developers
programs.next: Unity Asset Store package; early access applications for the Unity Editor integration; roadmap via genies.com/blog
programs.why: Unity-only today, so integration with a web runtime is awkward; useful as a competitor reference and as a landing page for stranded avatar developers.

programs.program: Kinetix emote SDK and studio integration grants
programs.apply: Contact Us page on kinetix.tech; no public application form found
benefits: Video-to-animation and emote SDK/API used by Unity Muse, OVERDARE and Mixamo (per kinetix.tech)
A grant of up to USD 75,000 for game-studio integrations is reported by a third-party review, not on Kinetix's own pages
programs.eligibility: Aimed at games with 3D avatar systems; integration grant claim unverified
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: Kinetix animation models now sit inside Mixamo and Unity Muse; a web-avatar emote integration is plausible but the program is game-studio oriented and not self-serve.

programs.program: Meta Movement SDK (body, face and eye tracking)
programs.apply: Open to Quest developers via Unity or Unreal packages; no partner application
benefits: Body, face and eye tracking retargeting samples (Unity sample updated 2026-05-11)
Unreal docs updated 2026-04-15
programs.eligibility: Quest 2/3/3S/Pro hardware
programs.next: Open to Quest developers via Unity or Unreal packages; no partner application
programs.why: Unity and Unreal only; only experimental WebXR body tracking exists, so fit is low unless we ship a Quest build.

programs.program: Cascadeur affiliate and education licensing
programs.apply: Email sales@cascadeur.com for education and bulk; affiliate terms not published in the results I could reach
benefits: Affiliate program mentioned in the FAQ
Educational edition for teachers and institutions
programs.eligibility: Sales approval
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: Physics-based keyframe tool; it exports FBX/GLB clips we can ingest, but Nekki has no public partner or startup program.

programs.program: Mocap Online IP-Share and custom animation services
programs.apply: Contact Motus Digital; sells on its own site, Fab and the Unity Asset Store
benefits: IP-Share: up to 50 percent discount on custom capture if Mocap Online also distributes the animations (non-exclusive licence back)
programs.eligibility: Animations may not be resold as standalone files; no open contributor program found
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: A way to commission clean-licence motion for our library, not a promotion channel.

programs.program: Truebones motion libraries licensing
programs.apply: Email the contact address on their site (listed on Gumroad); sold direct on Gumroad
benefits: BVH/FBX libraries (Motherlode, Pro-Bones, Zoo of 75+ animals)
Non-standard licence tiers; Zoo data not freely redistributable
programs.eligibility: Direct purchase; written terms needed to redistribute
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: Non-human rigs are a gap in our humanoid-only retargeter; any use in a public library needs explicit redistribution terms first.

programs.program: Xsens Indie Program
programs.apply: Buttons 'Apply for the Xsens Indie Program' / 'Request bundle pricing' on the page
benefits: Xsens Link, Awinda or Awinda Starter plus 12-month Animate Pro at 36 to 66 percent off list
Animate Pro renewals 50 percent off while eligible
Free Terry Notary performance-capture data for participants
Animation contest with Xsens Link prize, entries due 10 December (2026 per the contest URL)
programs.eligibility: Revenue or funding under USD 100,000 / EUR 100,000 last fiscal year, no AAA or enterprise work, must share behind-the-scenes content within 24 months
programs.next: Buttons 'Apply for the Xsens Indie Program' / 'Request bundle pricing' on the page
programs.why: Hardware purchase is poor value for a software platform; the free Notary data and the contest are the only direct hooks.
programs.promo_note: Participants must share a behind-the-scenes story; contest entries are shown by Xsens (stated as prizes, featuring not explicitly promised).

programs.program: Xsens Channel Partner Network
programs.apply: Form at https://www.xsens.com/channel-partners/become-a-channel-partner
benefits: Onboarding and training
Joint marketing programs
Partner resource library
Ongoing support
programs.eligibility: Aimed at distributors and value-added resellers; Xsens (Movella rebranded back to Xsens in 2026 per Wikipedia)
programs.next: Form at https://www.xsens.com/channel-partners/become-a-channel-partner
programs.why: Reseller track; relevant only if we ever bundle Xsens capture with a web-agent product.
programs.promo_note: Joint marketing programs are listed as a partner benefit; ask during onboarding.

programs.program: Noitom Perception Neuron MocapApi SDK and ecosystem
programs.apply: No public program; contact form at noitom.com/contact.html; MocapApi SDK on GitHub; Partners section on the About Us page
benefits: MocapApi SDK (successor to NeuronDataReader) and Axis Studio streaming
Integrations for Unreal, Unity, Blender, Cinema4D, MotionBuilder; Reallusion is a listed partner
programs.eligibility: Open SDK; no stated application
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: Same pattern as Rokoko: stream Axis Studio BVH into a web avatar. Low reach without a vendor relationship.

programs.program: OptiTrack NatNet SDK, Motive plugins and OEM
programs.apply: No program page found. NatNet SDK is a public download; OEM and custom engineering via OptiTrack sales
benefits: NatNet SDK for real-time streaming (C/C++/C#/Python, UDP/multicast)
Custom plugins, OEM and engineering services
programs.eligibility: Open SDK for licensed OptiTrack users
programs.next: Read the live program page, confirm eligibility and terms, then set eligible or skip
programs.why: No partner route; a NatNet-to-WebSocket bridge for streaming marker data to an agent avatar is a possible open-source showcase.

programs.program: TurboSquid publisher program
programs.apply: Publisher application on turbosquid.com
benefits: Retired for our purposes: TurboSquid does not accept AI-generated content for sale
programs.eligibility: Artists must prove IP ownership of everything submitted
programs.why: Not usable for Forge output; only hand-authored assets could be sold there.

programs.program: Vicon Markerless Pioneer Program
programs.apply: Contact form or email on the page to register interest in future cohorts
benefits: Direct knowledge exchange with Vicon senior management, product and development
Chance to shape the markerless roadmap
programs.eligibility: Active mocap users able to communicate regularly with Vicon
programs.cadence: VFX and VR cohort closed; Life Sciences and Engineering cohorts to reopen, no date
programs.next: Watch for the next window (VFX and VR cohort closed; Life Sciences and Engineering cohorts to reopen, no date) and apply when it opens
programs.why: Hardware vendor program for professional mocap users; we are not a capture studio. Register interest only if we add a Vicon-to-glTF import.

programs.program: Mixamo (auto-rigger and animation library)
programs.apply: No partner channel; Adobe community forum only. Free with an Adobe ID
benefits: Free royalty-free use of characters and animations in projects (per Adobe FAQ, a 'limited duration technology preview')
programs.eligibility: Adobe ID; redistribution of animations as standalone assets prohibited; machine-learning dataset use never clarified by Adobe
programs.why: Not a partner route. Our public clip library no longer serves Mixamo-sourced clips (api/animations/library.js filters them), so the action is written permission or continued replacement with CC0 packs. Evidence: api/animations/library.js.

programs.program: Meshcapade / MoCapade platform
programs.apply: None; online platforms were shut down after Epic acquired the company (announced 2026-02-18)
benefits: Retired: site says online platforms shut down as of April 18; technology expected inside MetaHuman and Unreal Engine
